paragraphs: Applied AI | Automation | Software Development | Business Systems I build internal software, AI systems, and workflow automation around real operational needs. My work includes local LLM deployment, RAG, search/retrieval systems, Microsoft Power Platform automation, desktop applications, API integrations, and business-process tooling. I focus on secure, maintainable systems with controlled access, human review, and room to expand as requirements change.
features: Selected professional systems are internal/proprietary; public repositories and demos are linked where available.
Automated technician intake, validation, approval routing, exception handling, and live project status across five work areas, eliminating 12+ hours of manual processing and coordination per week.

Locally hosted Qwen3 14B assistant using RAG and custom data-query tools to answer natural-language questions against project-tracker data while keeping sensitive company information on local infrastructure.

Local desktop search application scaling across 400,000+ active and historical project files, reducing manual server searches from hours each week to seconds or minutes through hybrid retrieval, relevance weighting, and…

Production desktop application that reduced a recurring monthly newsletter process from much of a workweek to roughly two hours through reusable issues, configurable layouts, live preview, PDF export, and self-service…
